job.question: What is the proposal submission deadline in the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System (OPERS) investment consulting services RFP?
job.acceptance: Accept Central Time/CT; explicit equivalent timezone conversion acceptable.

reviews.reason: This is a Broward Education Foundation investment manager services RFP, not the OPERS investment consulting services RFP. Its submission deadline therefore does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL TO PROVIDE INVESTMENT MANAGER SERVICES FOR BROWARD EDUCATION FOUNDATION, INC.

Six (6) copies of your proposal must be submitted to Thomas P. Severino, President and CEO, at the Broward Education Foundation, 600 SE Third Avenue, Ft. Lauderdale, FL, 33301, no later than 5 PM on July 1, 2016.
